content_sections.heading: ICSIL Science Graduate Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ICSIL Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download ICSIL Science Graduate Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Science Graduate: Bachelor of Science [B.Sc.] in Chemistry/Bio Chemistry/Biotechnology/Zoology/Industrial Chemistry/Environmental Chemistry/Botany as subject from a recognized university with minimum 55% or its CGPA equivalent OR M.Sc. in above field.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICSIL Science Graduate Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Intelligent Communication Systems India (ICSIL). It is a government job opportunity for eligible candidates seeking contractual employment in Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Science Graduate. ICSIL is looking to fill 3 vacancies for this position through a walk-in interview process.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Science Graduate post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Science Graduate post under the ICSIL Recruitment 2026. This offers a limited but valuable opportunity for qualified individuals.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for ICSIL Science Graduate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is "Walk-in". Candidates need to attend an interview directly on the specified date with all necessary documents, without any prior online application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date for the Science Graduate post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview date for the Science Graduate post is 29 September 2026. Candidates must ensure they report to the venue well in advance on this date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Science Graduate position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Science Graduate position is Rs. 24356 Per Month. This is a contractual position with a fixed monthly remuneration as per the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a B.Sc. in Chemistry/Bio Chemistry/Biotechnology/Zoology/Industrial Chemistry/Environmental Chemistry/Botany with minimum 55% or an M.Sc. in any of these fields from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q8. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee of Rs. 590 for both General/OBC and SC/ST categories. Candidates should be prepared to pay this fee at the time of the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Science Graduate post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Science Graduate post includes Document Verification followed by an Interview/Interaction. Candidates must clear both stages to be considered for the position.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted in New Delhi, Delhi, with the pincode 110054. The exact venue details will be specified in the official notification, which candidates must refer to.
